help.title: Help and support

faq.q1: How do I add an item?
faq.a1: In Wardrobe tap “+”, take a photo of the item or choose one from your gallery and pick its type. The AI will cut the item out of the background. If something went wrong, write a “Note for the AI” — for example, “without extra buttons” — and try again.
faq.q2: How do I try on a look?
faq.a2: Create an avatar from a selfie, then in Try-on choose items — one in each category — and tap “Try on”. In 10–40 seconds you'll see yourself in that look.
faq.a3: A credit is spent on adding an item, a new try-on and creating an avatar. Re-opening an already saved look and failed attempts are free. Your balance is shown at the top of the screens and in Profile.
faq.q4: How do I save a look and sort it into folders?
faq.a4: After a try-on tap “Save look”, give it a name and choose a folder or create a new one. All looks are in the Looks tab, with filters for folders and favorites.
faq.q5: If I change my avatar, will old looks change?
faq.a5: No. Saved looks stay as they were. New try-ons will be built on the updated avatar.
faq.a6: Only you. Photos are kept in private storage and open through a temporary link. More in “Privacy and data”.
faq.q7: How do I delete my account?
faq.a7: Profile → “Privacy and data” → “Delete account”. All items, looks, avatar and photos will be deleted — they can't be restored.
